ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access lets you add items to your wardrobe and choose your full-body photo for try-on.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets you photograph an item for your wardrobe or yourself for try-on.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission is needed to save try-on results to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is used only for the weather forecast when suggesting looks. Coordinates are not stored.
